description: Generated requests and expected labels authorized for the 24 former pending slots; not operator-authored or independently labelled evidence, and not approval of the draft catalogue.

requests.rationale: Generated expectation: only RIGHT_ALLEY_BACK is in scope and marker verification is excluded.

requests.request: The right alley needs a complete pass: front, middle, and back. No marker checks and no stops in the left alley.
requests.label: PLAN_ROUTE_RIGHT_ALLEY

requests.request: Both middle stations need a route pass, left and right. Those two only, with no marker verification.

requests.request: Please do a route-only check of the back station in each alley. Skip the fronts and middles.

requests.request: I need every marker verified in the left alley: front, middle, and back. Don't include the right alley.

requests.label: PLAN_VERIFIED_RIGHT_ALLEY
requests.rationale: Generated expectation: confirming every right-alley tag requires the verified right-alley plan.

requests.request: We need the full inspection this time. Visit all six stations across both alleys and verify every marker.
requests.label: PLAN_VERIFIED_FULL_SITE
requests.rationale: Generated expectation: all six stations with marker verification match the draft verified full-site plan.

requests.request: I said the back pair earlier, but scratch that. Make it the two middle stations only, one in each alley, and keep it route-only.
requests.label: PLAN_ROUTE_MIDDLE_PAIR
requests.rationale: Generated expectation: the explicit correction replaces the back pair with the route-only middle pair.

requests.request: Forget my earlier request for the left alley. What I need now is marker verification at all three right-alley stations, and nowhere else.
requests.label: PLAN_VERIFIED_RIGHT_ALLEY
requests.rationale: Generated expectation: the final explicit scope replaces the left alley with the verified right-alley plan.
